# Shyena Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

> Cybersecurity for connected systems: hardware, firmware, IoT, and OT / ICS
> security assessments, security projects for practice and security workflows,
> and practical cybersecurity learning. Based in Lalitpur, Nepal, and serving
> organizations in Nepal and international markets.

This site is the main Shyena Technologies website at https://shyenasec.com.
Page-by-page details are in [llms-full.txt](https://shyenasec.com/llms-full.txt).

## Company pages

- [Home](https://shyenasec.com/): Hardware, firmware, connected device, and OT / ICS security assessments, with the six service areas and case focus areas of the company.
- [About](https://shyenasec.com/about): Company information for Shyena Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a cybersecurity and technology company registered in Nepal.
- [Projects](https://shyenasec.com/projects): Index of security projects built around practical cybersecurity learning and security workflows.
- [Blog](https://shyenasec.com/blog): Practical articles on security assessment scope and methods.
- [Contact](https://shyenasec.com/contact): Contact form with selectable inquiry topics; general email whois@shyenasec.com.

## Security projects

- [FlagForge](https://shyenasec.com/projects/flagforge): A public capture-the-flag platform for practicing web security, cryptography, reverse engineering, and forensics at flagforgectf.com.
- [SAFE](https://shyenasec.com/projects/safe): Endpoint AI detection and response. Prompts sent to AI services are checked on the device, and risky ones are stopped before they leave. Details at https://safe-website-flax.vercel.app/.
- [SecYourFlow](https://shyenasec.com/projects/secyourflow): A private security workflow project that brings security assets, findings, and follow-up into a clearer view. Available for demonstration on request.

## Services

- [Hardware VAPT](https://shyenasec.com/#service-hardware-vapt): Review of hardware, firmware, and exposed interfaces within an agreed assessment scope.
- [OT / ICS assessment](https://shyenasec.com/#service-ot-ics): Assessment of industrial control environments, including PLC, DCS, and SCADA components.
- [IoT security testing](https://shyenasec.com/#service-iot-security): Review of device interfaces, firmware, companion applications, and connected services as applicable.
- [SCADA network testing](https://shyenasec.com/#service-scada-testing): Testing of protocol exposure, network segmentation, and access controls in a controlled engagement.
- [Red team operations](https://shyenasec.com/#service-red-team): Exercise of agreed attack paths across connected IT and OT environments with operating constraints in scope.
- [Compliance and risk advisory](https://shyenasec.com/#service-risk-advisory): Identification of security gaps and a practical, prioritized path for risk treatment.

## Articles

- [Scoping an OT security assessment around operational limits](https://shyenasec.com/blog/ot-security-assessment-scope): A practical checklist for defining boundaries, dependencies, and operating constraints before an OT or ICS security assessment.
- [What a hardware security review can cover](https://shyenasec.com/blog/hardware-vapt-review): An overview of common hardware and firmware review areas, from exposed interfaces to the device's update and trust model.
- [Reviewing IoT security across a connected device](https://shyenasec.com/blog/iot-device-security-review): How a device security review can include hardware, firmware, mobile applications, cloud services, and the links between them.
